notices.short_title: Notice of Public Hearing and Opportunity to Comment-  Amendments to Highway Rules
notices.plain: The Department of Transportation will hold a public hearing on March 9, 2026, on proposed amendments to its highway rules, and the public may comment.

notices.short_title: TRUCK, HALF TON DIESEL POWERED PICKUP FOR THE CITY OF NEW YORK
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Ecodrive II LLC a $10.1 million contract for half-ton diesel-powered pickup trucks for New York City, selected through competitive sealed bids in which the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: Non-Residential Program Support Services, Bronx
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded Violence Intervention Program Inc a $3.2 million contract for non-residential program support services in the Bronx, chosen from competing proposals within a pre-qualified list of approved vendors.

notices.short_title: HWP20MKC - NON-STANDARD PEDESTRIAN RAMP INSTALLATIONS, MANHATTAN & BROOKLYN
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction is seeking bids, due March 2, 2026, for construction-related work installing non-standard pedestrian ramps in Manhattan and Brooklyn, with the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.short_title: MODULAR PUBLIC BATHROOM INSTALLATION AND MAINTENANCE SERVICES, CITYWIDE
notices.plain: The Economic Development Corporation is seeking proposals from vendors to install and maintain modular public bathrooms citywide, with responses due Feb. 24, 2026.

notices.short_title: Government to Government Contract
notices.plain: The Department of Education intends to award a goods and services contract to another government agency, with responses due Feb. 17, 2026.

notices.short_title: Requirements Contract for Central Station Monitoring of Fire Alarm Systems
notices.plain: The Department of Education is seeking bids, due May 7, 2026, from companies that would provide central station monitoring of fire alarm systems under a requirements contract, with the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.short_title: BWS Design Review for Stream Restoration 6019326X
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded Auroran Environmental LLC a $235,510 contract for design review of stream restoration work, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: Monitoring of security alarm system at BWSO facilities in the 5 boroughs of NYC & Yonkers
notices.vendor_name: United States Merchants Protective Co., Inc
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection renewed its contract with United States Merchants Protective Co., Inc. for $150,330 to monitor security alarm systems at Bureau of Water Supply facilities in the five boroughs of New York City and Yonkers.

notices.short_title: Warehouse Cleaning Services
notices.vendor_name: New York State Industries for the Disabled Inc
notices.plain: The Department of Finance awarded New York State Industries for the Disabled Inc a $39,744 contract for warehouse cleaning services, using a method the law requires for this type of purchase.

notices.short_title: OPEN-ENDED  JUSTICE INVOLVED SUPPORTIVE HOUSING (JISH)
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene is seeking proposals for open-ended justice-involved supportive housing services, with responses due Dec. 30, 2039, through a competition limited to pre-qualified vendors.

notices.short_title: Shelter for Families with Children
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services intends to renew its contract for shelter for families with children, with responses due Feb. 9, 2026.

notices.short_title: IBC Quality Control Class II
notices.plain: The Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications renewed its contract with Innovative Business Concepts, Inc., for quality control services, valued at $10 million.

notices.short_title: Inspection, Maintenance, and Repair of Back Flow Prevention Assemblies for NYC Parks Citywide
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation has published a notice about inspecting, maintenance and repair of backflow prevention assemblies for New York City parks citywide.

notices.short_title: Brooklyn Navy Yard Development Corporation Economic Development Sole Source Contract
notices.plain: The Department of Small Business Services has published a notice of a sole source contract with the Brooklyn Navy Yard Development Corporation for economic development, open to public comment.

notices.short_title: FOR ACQUISITION - Block 7071, Lot 125
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services will hold a public hearing on March 25, 2026, about a proposed acquisition of property at Block 7071, Lot 125.

notices.short_title: Weekly Fuel Price Schedule Week of 02/02/26
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services posted its weekly fuel price schedule for the week of Feb. 2, 2026, in the city's official contracts journal.

notices.short_title: LL63/NYPD/EXT
notices.plain: The Mayor's Office of Contract Services published a Feb. 6, 2026 notice titled "LL63/NYPD/EXT" under Special Materials, but the title alone does not say what it covers beyond a reference to the NYPD and an extension.

notices.short_title: LL63/DPR-C/NEW
notices.plain: The Mayor's Office of Contract Services published a notice on Feb. 6, 2026, under the title "LL63/DPR-C/NEW," which gives too few details to say more about what it covers.
